This stuff is legit! And such a simple routine, too. I used to have to do so many steps with a previous routine that some nights I would just get lazy and skip it. And it didn't really make much of a difference. With JiYu, though, just 2 simple steps and you're done. The results are amazing as well. My skin is glowing, smooth, and over all just looks healthier.

I stumbled upon JiYu on my search for a new skincare routine when I suddenly broke out after having to take an emergency contraceptive which messed up my hormones. I did only one bundle of the toner pads and moisturizer until it was finished, and now my skin has upgraded to better. Mind you, I have extremely sensitive skin, so make-up and other products causes me to break out. I cannot wear make-up so it's really important for me to have clear skin.

Purchased 2 more sets which should last me months! I love how much you get out of just 1 set. Totally worth the money!

I look forward to getting better and better skin over time.
